title: Completion after fixing a coordinate to its value
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates, let $i$ be a coordinate, let $s$ be a sign, and let $x$ be a binary vector of length $n$. If the completion of $\rho$ using $x$ has value $s$ at coordinate $i$, then completing the restriction obtained by fixing coordinate $i$ to $s$, still using $x$, leaves the completed sign vector unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a binary vector of length $n$
the completion of $\rho$ using $x$ has value $s$ at $i$
